name: Field Gradient
standard_name: slope of the per-strike gamma profile (dGEX/dK); Terrain strike rail

name: Polarity
standard_name: put/call volume or premium ratio; net premium sign

name: Equilibrium
standard_name: VWAP / volume point-of-control / gamma flip (all exist)

name: Magnetic Pull
standard_name: strike pinning (tested as Gravity Well: no attraction)

name: Dipole Moment
standard_name: call-wall minus put-wall distance vs the implied move

name: Electric Potential Map
standard_name: integrated gamma profile = Potential Energy Map row

name: Coulomb Repulsion
standard_name: contradicts its own sibling (pull); same data as walls

name: Faraday Shock
standard_name: OI change z-score by strike (book/oiChange exists)

name: Shielding
standard_name: net/gross gamma ratio (how much of the book offsets)

name: Viscosity
standard_name: Amihud illiquidity / Kyle lambda on 1-min bars (tested: ~0 beyond relative volume; display-only for single names)

name: Turbulence
standard_name: Kritzman-Li turbulence (Mahalanobis distance of cross-asset returns)

name: Laminar/Turbulent State
standard_name: regime label from vol level + efficiency ratio

name: Pressure Gradient
standard_name: NBBO size imbalance (quote imbalance); full depth is L2 = UNAVAILABLE

name: Laminar Trend Score
standard_name: R^2 of a linear fit to price (efficiency ratio)

name: Boundary Layer
standard_name: behaviour at a level = wall back-test (docs/wall-backtest.md)

name: Liquidity Vortex
standard_name: repeated tests of a level; wall back-test found re-tests add ~nothing

name: Cavitation
standard_name: low-volume nodes of the volume profile

name: Market Entropy
standard_name: Shannon entropy of binned returns -> permutation entropy row

name: Permutation Entropy
standard_name: Bandt-Pompe permutation entropy (tested: no vol gain on 4 of 5 names, no direction)

name: Volatility Half-Life
standard_name: AR(1)/HAR mean-reversion half-life of realised vol (tested)

name: Kinetic Energy
standard_name: volume x squared return ~ realised variance

name: Potential Energy Map
standard_name: dealer hedging potential = integrated gamma profile; its curvature at spot is net dealer gamma (tested: +3.7pp R2 on the day RV over HAR+VIX)

name: Sample Entropy
standard_name: Richman-Moorman sample entropy (tested beside permutation entropy)

name: Cooling Rate
standard_name: vol decay after a spike = half-life row

name: Frequency Spectrum
standard_name: periodogram of returns: white apart from intraday seasonality

name: Wavelet Decomposition
standard_name: MODWT multiresolution (denoising tool, not a signal)

name: Phase Synchronization
standard_name: Hilbert phase locking across timeframes (tested: no edge over plain sign agreement)

name: Wave Interference
standard_name: sum of cycle components = phase synchronisation row

name: Dominant Cycle
standard_name: Ehlers dominant cycle; returns have no stable cycle

name: Resonance
standard_name: OPEX / calendar effects on vol and pinning

name: Fourier Forecast
standard_name: extrapolating a non-stationary spectrum: classic overfit

name: Cross-Timeframe Alignment
standard_name: plain multi-horizon momentum sign agreement (the phase test baseline; no edge either)

name: Escape Velocity
standard_name: range-compression breakout strength (tested: no continuation; size signal = the breakout bar alone; Compass has range compression + OR break)

name: Elastic Reversion
standard_name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reversion to VWAP (VWAP z, Compass input)

name: Rebound Coefficient
standard_name: bounce ratio at a wall = wall back-test

name: Friction
standard_name: bid-ask spread / trading cost (spread/mid is a Compass input)

name: Spring Constant
standard_name: OU mean-reversion speed kappa = half-life row

name: Collision
standard_name: a touch of a wall (wall back-test)

name: Market Lyapunov
standard_name: Rosenstein largest Lyapunov exponent: unidentifiable on short noisy returns

name: DFA Persistence
standard_name: detrended fluctuation analysis (tested: no continuation edge, not better than variance ratio)

name: Multifractal Spectrum
standard_name: MF-DFA spectrum width (needs long windows; daily use only)

name: Critical Transition Detector
standard_name: critical slowing down: rising AR(1) + variance (tested: AR(1) part AUC 0.49-0.51 = coin flip; variance part = the vol ratio a HAR already holds)

name: Correlation Dimension
standard_name: Grassberger-Procaccia: needs far more clean data than exists

name: Flickering (EWS)
standard_name: bimodality early warning = critical transition row

name: Variance Ratio
standard_name: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio (the plain persistence measure; tested as the baseline: no edge either)

name: Tunneling Probability
standard_name: probability of touching a level before expiry (barrier-hit ~ 2x delta) vs empirical wall breaks

name: Probability Cloud
standard_name: implied-move band from the ATM straddle

name: Signal Polarization
standard_name: agreement of signals -> cross-timeframe alignment row (only meaningful if signals are independent)

name: Absorption
standard_name: volume absorbed at a level without a move (Viscosity at the level)

name: Lens Focus
standard_name: Herfindahl concentration of gamma / OI across strikes

name: Luminosity
standard_name: volume vs its intraday curve (Compass input)

name: Opacity
standard_name: off-exchange share: needs TRF-tagged prints; UNAVAILABLE as built

name: Prism
standard_name: flow by participant type: UNAVAILABLE (no participant IDs)

name: Market Diffusion
standard_name: realised variance per unit time; anomalous-diffusion exponent = variance ratio / Hurst

name: Magnetization
standard_name: breadth: share of constituents / sectors moving with the index

name: Boltzmann Returns
standard_name: a distribution fit, not a signal

name: Mean Free Path
standard_name: time between directional changes = intrinsic-time row

name: Gravity Well
standard_name: strike pinning to the largest-gamma strike (tested on the rebuilt SPY book: no attraction, slight drift away; pull direction n.s.)

name: Market Clock
standard_name: intrinsic time: volume / directional-change bars (Guillaume et al.)

name: Gravitational Wave Scanner
standard_name: market-to-single-name volatility spillover (HAR-X; tested: +0.6-1.0pp R2 on AAPL, ~+0.15 on NVDA, ~0.1 between ETFs)

name: Orbit
standard_name: oscillation around a level = pinning row

name: Lagrange Points
standard_name: midpoint between walls: no evidence of meaning

name: Shock Propagation
standard_name: cross-asset lead-lag = Gravitational Wave Scanner row
